title: Retry native LDBC command-mode smoke with Q14 enabled

steps.step: Continue from BENCHPROD-110 after Q14 weightedpaths profiler no longer timed out on full test-data
Add optional Q14 message-index creation to ldbc_snb_native_smoke.py for command-mode native runs
Run Q14-enabled full test-data native LDBC command-mode smoke with 10 requested operations
Classify the initial LdbcQuery1 nested array failure separately from the Q14 weightedpaths fix
Fix projection dependency extraction for array_agg(ARRAY[...]) expressions and add regression coverage
Rebuild release binary and rerun Q14-enabled native smoke
Run focused Rust and bench-harness verification after the final array projection fix
Record smoke evidence conservatively without claiming full official LDBC coverage

verification: python -m py_compile external_bootstrap.py ldbc_snb_native_smoke.py ldbc_q14_profile.py: passed
cargo test --release --test pg_integration -- --nocapture: final rerun passed 28/28

result.smoke_scope: command-mode LDBC SNB Interactive PostgreSQL implementation, preloaded PostgreSQL test-data, Q14 indexes enabled, 10 requested operations, warmup 0, duration 10 seconds

initial_gap.error: ClassCastException: class [Ljava.lang.String; cannot be cast to class [[Ljava.lang.Object;
initial_gap.root_cause: Projection pushdown dependency extraction missed Expr::Array elements inside array_agg(ARRAY[...]), so nested array result materialization lost required inputs.

result.current_frontier: Q14-enabled native command-mode smoke passes for the small full-testdata run, but full official LDBC coverage remains unproven because the PostgreSQL implementation still reports missing complex-query/update SQL files and the operation mix is narrow.

remaining_blockers: Missing LDBC PostgreSQL query files still appear in stderr: interactive-complex-3-duration-as-function.sql, interactive-complex-4-duration-as-function.sql, interactive-complex-7-with-second.sql, and several interactive-update SQL files.
The successful smoke exercised LdbcQuery1, LdbcQuery14, and short queries 1-7 only; it did not prove all complex queries or updates.
This evidence is not a full official/native LDBC benchmark pass.
Native memtier remains blocked by missing real memtier_benchmark tooling.
next_task: BENCHPROD-112 candidate: supply or fix the missing LDBC PostgreSQL query/update SQL files, then broaden command-mode native smoke operation coverage and keep pass labels separated by operation mix.
